authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Full truṭyati includes Prakrit tuṭṭai/ṭuṭṭai and the associated tuṭṭa “broken”, with Lahnda/Punjabi ṭuṭṭ-, Nepali ṭuṭnu, Bihari ṭūṭal and Hindi ṭūṭā. These whole survey responses retain that break stem with regional infinitive or participial morphology (-eko, -la/-lo, -yā/-eā); the dental/retroflex and aspiration notation is preserved. Responses containing go/be auxiliaries, a negative particle, or two stems are excluded.
